data.text: Second pass on the landing page, after the owner's review: still too much text, and the text renderings of CLI output read as mock-ups. Every block is now a headline, one line and a real screenshot of kadence (hook, prime, search, kadence ui) taken by kadence-site/demo/screens/record.sh with vhs from a clone of this repository. A UX review, a QA pass and a code review ran before merge; PR bogutskiandriy/kadence-site#27.
